title: Who Is the Best Stripe Connect Alternative?
summary: Looking for a Stripe Connect alternative? Compare Usio’s embedded payments, revenue sharing, U.S. expertise, and dedicated support.
body_markdown:
Stripe Connect is a big name in


[embedded payments](https://usio.com/why-saas-platforms-should-take-control-of-the-payments-experience/) . It is global, developer-friendly, and recognizable enough that suggesting it in a strategy meeting probably will not get you kicked out of the room.


But the biggest name is not automatically the best fit.


For software companies serving the U.S. economy, the better question is not:


**“Which payment platform has the biggest logo?”**


It is:


**“Which payment partner will help us generate revenue, support our developers, serve our customers, and manage more of the money movement lifecycle?”**


That is where


**Usio** enters the conversation.


Usio gives startups and established


[SaaS platforms](https://usio.com/software-as-a-service/) the infrastructure to accept payments, issue cards, disburse funds, automate billing communications, and monetize payment activity. Instead of handing your developers an application programming interface and wishing them good luck, Usio pairs its technology with hands-on support and U.S. payment expertise.


In other words, Usio does not just help your platform move money.


**Usio helps your platform make money from moving money.**


## **Stripe Connect Is Global. Usio Is Focused on the U.S. Economy.**


Stripe Connect was designed for companies operating across multiple countries, currencies, and regulatory environments.


That global reach can be valuable. But if your platform primarily serves customers in the United States, you may not need payment infrastructure built to conquer the planet.


You may need a payment partner that specializes in:


- U.S. card and ACH payment infrastructure


- Payment facilitation


- Recurring and account-based payments


- Merchant onboarding


- Card issuing


- Funds disbursement


- Refunds and reimbursements


- Electronic billing


- Printed statements, invoices, checks, and notices


- U.S. compliance and operational requirements


[Usio is a Nacha Certified](https://www.nacha.org/content/usio) Third-Party Sender, giving software companies access to a partner with recognized ACH payment expertise.


You do not need a payment passport. You need infrastructure that understands where your customers live, how they pay, and where the money needs to go next.


## **Do Not Pay for Global Capabilities You Rarely Use**


Stripe Connect’s global infrastructure can be valuable if your company needs international markets, multiple currencies, and cross-border payment flows.


But if most of your customers and transactions are in the United States, ask a practical question:


**Are you paying more for global capabilities you do not use, or barely use?**


It is a little like paying for an international first-class lounge membership when most of your trips are to the grocery store. Impressive? Sure. Necessary? Probably not.


The right comparison is not simply which provider has the longest feature list. It is which provider delivers the strongest value for the services your company will actually use.


Processing rates and total costs vary by program, transaction volume, payment method, risk profile, and agreement. SaaS leaders should compare the complete cost of each provider rather than assume the largest global platform automatically provides the best economics for a U.S.-focused payment program.


Usio offers a more specialized approach built around domestic card processing, ACH, payment facilitation, card issuing, funds disbursement, billing, and dedicated account support.


**Do not pay for the whole world when your business is thriving right here at home.**

Usio’s compliance materials identify the company as HIPAA compliant and Nacha certified. They also identify Usio as a PCI Level 1 service provider. Usio’s embedded payment materials promote revenue sharing, access to live developers and Certified Payments Professionals, automated merchant onboarding, and proprietary technology maintained in-house.


Usio also has a perfect 5 Star rating based on 24 reviews listed on G2. Reviewers highlight responsive support, proactive communication, reliable performance, and simplified ACH processing.


## **A Meaningful Difference for Healthcare SaaS**


For healthcare software companies, payment functionality is only part of the decision. The way sensitive information is handled matters too.


Usio is HIPAA compliant and Nacha certified, creating a compelling advantage for U.S. healthcare platforms that need to connect patient payments, refunds, reimbursements, electronic billing, printed statements, and ACH workflows.


Stripe is not positioned as a HIPAA-compliant platform for receiving or storing protected health information. Healthcare organizations may use its payment-processing services when protected health information is kept out of Stripe’s systems, but that creates an important boundary the software platform must carefully maintain.


For healthcare SaaS, Usio offers more than payment processing. It provides a U.S.-focused payment relationship built around the compliance, billing, and money-movement realities of healthcare.


## **Revenue Share Should Not Be an Afterthought**


Here is where the conversation gets interesting.


Your customers are already making payments through your software. Every month, money moves through the platform you built, maintain, market, support, and improve.


So why should someone else keep all the payment revenue?


Usio offers revenue-sharing opportunities that allow SaaS companies to participate in the economics of payment activity from the beginning of the program. Instead of treating payments as a box that needs to be checked, Usio helps turn them into a potential source of recurring revenue.


That changes the strategic value of payments. They are no longer just another integration sitting on the product roadmap between “fix login bug” and “update privacy policy.” Payments can become part of your:


- Revenue strategy


- Customer retention strategy


- Product differentiation


- Margin expansion


- Growth story


- Platform valuation


- Customer experience


Your software is doing the work. It should be invited to the revenue party.


## **Your Dedicated Account Representative Is a Certified Payments Professional**


Good documentation matters. Developers love good documentation. But documentation cannot join a troubleshooting call, understand an unusual payment flow, or help your team think through a complicated launch. With Usio, your dedicated account representative is a


**Certified Payments Professional** , or CPP.


That means the person responsible for your relationship understands payments and can become familiar with your program, customers, payment flows, and business objectives. Your team also receives hands-on developer support throughout the integration process. Usio’s embedded payments materials specifically emphasize access to live developers, Certified Payments Professionals, and other payments experts.


This matters because embedded payments rarely involve only one decision.


There are merchant onboarding requirements, ACH rules, card processing considerations, transaction flows, settlement questions, reporting needs, reconciliation, disbursement methods, refunds, risk, and compliance.


Suddenly, your “simple payment integration” has become a group project involving product, finance, engineering, legal, operations, and someone who joined the meeting five minutes ago but is already deeply concerned.


Usio gives you a dedicated CPP who can help your team navigate that complexity, backed by developers who can assist with the technical details.


**You are not simply handed a login and pointed toward a help center. You have an experienced payments professional who knows your business and is accountable for helping your program succeed.**


## **Usio Handles More Than Money Coming In**


Most embedded payment discussions focus on accepting money.


That is important, obviously. Money coming in is generally considered a positive development.


But what happens when money needs to go back out?


Your platform may need to:


- Refund a patient


- Pay a property owner


- Reimburse a resident


- Send insurance claim funds


- Distribute government benefits


- Pay a carrier or contractor


- Issue an incentive


- Deliver emergency funds


- Send a physical or virtual card


- Print and mail a check


This is where Usio’s broader money movement platform becomes especially valuable.


Usio supports payment acceptance, ACH processing, card issuing, real-time payments, and multiple forms of funds disbursement. Its recipient-choice capabilities can include delivery to a bank account, debit card, or printed check.


Instead of using one provider for payment acceptance, another for payouts, another for card programs, and yet another for checks, SaaS companies can consolidate more of the financial lifecycle with Usio.

## **Yes, Usio Still Handles Paper**


We know. It is 2026. Surely everything is digital now. Except it is not.


Government agencies, healthcare organizations, utilities, property managers, lenders, legal offices, associations, and other businesses still rely on printed statements, invoices, checks, and notices.


Usio supports digital money movement while also offering in-house bill print and mail capabilities. Its services include invoice and statement printing, mailing, electronic bill presentment, document warehousing, and payment processing. Because sometimes the most innovative payment solution is the one that understands a check still has to arrive in somebody’s mailbox.


## **The Real Advantage: One Accountable Partner**


The strongest argument for Usio is not one isolated feature.


It is the ability to consolidate more of the payment lifecycle with one accountable U.S. payment partner.


Usio can help SaaS companies:


- Accept card and ACH payments


- Embed payments under their own brand


- Participate in payment revenue


- Support automated merchant onboarding


- Issue physical and virtual cards


- Send digital disbursements


- Support real-time payments


- Deliver ACH payments


- Print and mail checks


- Produce and mail bills, statements, and notices


- Access hands-on developer support


- Work with a dedicated Certified Payments Professional


- Support HIPAA-compliant healthcare payment workflows


- Work with a Nacha Certified Third-Party Sender


Usio’s platform brings together embedded payments, ACH, card issuing, funds disbursement, payment processing, and bill print and mail.


That can reduce vendor sprawl, simplify operations, and give your team one place to go when questions arise.


One partner. One relationship. Far fewer games of vendor ping-pong.


## **Is Usio the Best Stripe Connect Alternative?**


Stripe Connect remains a strong platform, especially for companies that need extensive international reach and broad global payment coverage.


But global scale is not every company’s goal.


If you are building a SaaS platform for the U.S. economy, Usio deserves serious consideration.


Usio may be the better choice if you want to:


- Monetize payments from the beginning of a qualifying program


- Work with a U.S.-focused payment partner


- Avoid paying for global capabilities you may rarely use


- Work with a HIPAA-compliant payment platform


- Use a Nacha Certified Third-Party Sender


- Have a dedicated account representative who is a Certified Payments Professional


- Receive hands-on developer support


- Build card issuing into your offering


- Send funds through multiple payment methods


- Combine payment acceptance and disbursements


- Add electronic billing and bill print and mail


- Consolidate multiple payment vendors


- Create a more complete B2B2C payment experience


Stripe Connect helps platforms connect to payments.


Usio helps platforms accept money, send money, manage money, and make money from the experience.


For startups, healthcare technology companies, property management platforms, GovTech providers, LegalTech, fitness software, logistics platforms, nonprofits, donor platforms, associations, insurers, utilities, lenders, marketplaces, and other vertical SaaS companies serving the United States, Usio is not merely another Stripe Connect alternative.


**It may be the**[smarter business model.](https://usio.com/contact/)
